# REP Fitness

> > REP Fitness is a home and commercial gym equipment supplier engineering strength training equipment including power racks, functional trainers, adjustable benches, and dumbbells from their Colorado headquarters.

Founded by brothers Ryan and Shane McGrotty, REP Fitness designs and manufactures premium fitness equipment for home gyms and commercial strength & conditioning facilities. The company operates from Denver, Colorado with showrooms in multiple states and international distribution through Denmark for European markets.

## Key Topics

- Power Racks (PR-5000, PR-4000, PR-1100)
- Functional Trainers (Arcadia Max, Ares 2.0, Athena)
- Adjustable Benches (AB-5200, AB-3000, AB-3100, BlackWing)
- Adjustable Dumbbells (PÉPIN, QuickDraw)
- Strength Training Equipment
- Home Gym Setup
- Commercial Gym Equipment
- CrossFit & Conditioning
- Colorado Engineering & Design
- Warranty & Customer Support
- Equipment Buying Guides
- Cable Machines & Towers
